scope: Active P1/P2/P3 only. For this medtech device issuer (HIFU prostate-tissue-ablation devices), task rule says report only ACTIVE pivotal/IDE clinical studies of company's own devices, not investigator-initiated.

website.note: edap-tms.com 301-redirects to focalone.com. /pipeline page is 404. Site lists Focal One i HIFU robotic system as the marketed product and references the HIFI study (peer-reviewed, completed).

trials.note: Legacy 2006-start trial of Ablatherm; status UNKNOWN since ~2012; not active.
Investigator-initiated study of Focal One HIFU; EDAP-TMS Focal One collaborator.

products.name: Focal One i Robotic HIFU System
products.status: FDA 510(k) cleared (initial Focal One: 2018-06-07; 2025 510(k) clearance for new ultrasound imaging and workflow enhancements). CE Marked since 2013-06-18. Marketed in U.S., Europe, Canada, Korea, Russia, Brazil and other countries. Indicated for prostate tissue ablation.

products.name: Ablatherm HIFU (legacy)
products.status: Earlier-generation HIFU prostate device; predecessor to Focal One.

products.name: ESWL (Sonolith i-move) lithotripsy
products.status: Discontinued: company stopped selling Sonolith i-move in H2 2025; service of installed base continues.

supporting_clinical_evidence.name: HIFI study
supporting_clinical_evidence.design: Largest prospective comparative multi-center study of prostate cancer treatments (HIFU vs surgery).
supporting_clinical_evidence.status: Results published December 2024 in European Urology (Ploussard G. et al.). Met primary endpoint of non-inferiority for Salvage Treatment-free Survival at 30 months.
supporting_clinical_evidence.note: Supports approved/marketed Focal One; not forward pipeline.

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: Phase 2/3 study with status UNKNOWN since 2012; superseded by Focal One generations.

excluded_partner_owned.asset: Focal One HIFU in prostate cancer (UF study)
excluded_partner_owned.reason: Investigator-initiated study with EDAP-TMS Focal One as collaborator; per task rules, investigator-initiated trials of device companies are excluded.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Medical device company (HIFU robotic system for prostate tissue ablation). Focal One i is FDA-cleared and marketed; R&D consists of incremental device/software/AI enhancements pursued via 510(k) line extensions (2025 510(k) clearance obtained), not new investigational drug or pivotal IDE studies sponsored by the company. The only company-sponsored ctgov study is a legacy UNKNOWN-status Ablatherm trial; other Focal One ctgov entries are investigator-initiated and excluded per task rules.
